concerns.text: FR-001 (Generate 10,000 matrices) and US-1 are not covered by an executable task. T017c is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`) and explicitly requires T019a_jsonl, T019b, and T021 which are marked complete but T017c itself is the only task that actually performs the generation loop. Without T017c being executable, the dataset required for US-2 and US-3 cannot be produced.

FR-008 (Theoretical Lower Bound) and SC-002 are not covered by an executable task. T009_calc is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`). The task description requires implementing `code/analysis/theoretical_lower_bound.py` and generating `data/analysis/theoretical_lower_bound.json`, but the task is not checked, blocking the validation logic in T032_bound and T005a.

FR-005 (Latency Profiling) and SC-003 are not covered by an executable task. T042 is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`). While T050 (Revision) proposes merging T042 into T027d, T027d itself is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). There is no completed task that implements the `time.perf_counter()` logic required to measure wall-clock time per token.

FR-007 (Sensitivity Analysis) and SC-005 are not covered by an executable task. T005a is marked as incomplete (`- [ ]`). The task requires sweeping epsilon values and running the simulation loop, but T027d (the loop) is also incomplete. No completed task exists to perform the sweep or generate `data/analysis/epsilon_sensitivity.json`.

FR-006 (Paired t-test, n=30) and SC-004 are not fully covered. T031 (t-test implementation) is marked complete, but T030b (Execution of 30 runs) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Without T030b, the input data for T031 does not exist. T030c1 (Aggregation) is also incomplete. The chain of execution required to produce the 30 runs is broken.

The plan requires a unified entry point (`code/main.py`) to orchestrate the workflow (Data Gen -> Training -> Simulation). T046 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Without this, the `quickstart.md` validation (T038a) cannot execute the full pipeline as required by the plan and spec.

The plan requires correcting data flow dependencies (T049). T049 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). While this is a 'Revision' task, the current state of the task list has T030b (Execution) depending on T027d (Implementation), but T027d is incomplete. The dependency graph is currently invalid for execution.

FR-005 (Latency) integration is not covered. T050 (Merge T042 into T027d) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). Since T027d is incomplete, the latency profiling logic is not present in the simulation runner.
FR-007 (Sensitivity) integration is not covered. T051 (Merge T005a into T030b/T027d) is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`). The sensitivity sweep logic is not integrated into the execution path.

T052, T053, T054 are verification tasks for incomplete features (T027d, T030b, T033). While verification tasks are valid, they are currently impossible to execute because the features they verify (T027d, T030b) are incomplete. This creates a 'stale' verification state where the tasks exist but cannot be performed.
